The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/deutkw/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in German, translation by Kautzsch und Weizsäcker 1906
> Public Domain
> Language: Deutsch (German, Standard)
> Dieser Textbibel wird Ihnen mit freundlicher Genehmigung von eBible.org zur Verfügung gestellt, mit der Hilfe unserer Partner, die für den Erhalt unserer Dienste spenden.
> This Public Domain Bible text is provided to you courtesy of eBible.org with help from our partners who donate to keep our servers and services running.
> Quelle: Textbibel.de (Hans J. Herbst Mitarbeit bei der Digitalisierung) ist frei!
> 2025-08-30

Why this is public domain:
Text: the Kautzsch-Weizsäcker "Textbibel", 2nd edition, Tübingen, J. C. B. Mohr, 1906. People: Emil Kautzsch 1841-1910, Carl Heinrich Weizsäcker 1822-1899 (New Testament), and the Old Testament contributors Friedrich Baethgen 1849-1905, Hermann Guthe 1849-1936, Adolf Kamphausen 1829-1910, Rudolf Kittel 1853-1929, Max Löhr 1864-1931, Karl Marti 1855-1925, Wilhelm Rothstein 1853-1926, Rudolf Rüetschi 1820-1903, Viktor Ryssel 1849-1905, Carl Siegfried 1830-1903, Albert Socin 1844-1899. US: published before 1931. Germany: life plus 70 years; the last death, Guthe's, was in 1936, so the term ended in 2006. eBible names Textbibel.de and Hans J. Herbst for the digitization, which adds no author.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=deutkw), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/deutkw/copyright.htm), https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Textbibel; https://archive.org/details/text-1906-nt-apg; Wikidata entries of each contributor; https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carl_Siegfried; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries%27_copyright_lengths; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-deutkw-7532e3e8, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
